body: Founder: 'load bearing has made it into the vocabulary of the emily way' -- term originated in a TYLER Series X scene note about a piano. Added as THE_EMILY_WAY.md Principle 17, grounded in a real recent incident (okemily-deploy.sh's blog/ exclusion flag, a real 2026-07-19 data-loss near-miss, and tyler/'s identical near-repeat caught same-day). Published a reflective blog post, 'Load-Bearing' (author: Emily Prime), tracing the term's drift from fiction into doctrine and riffing on architecture vocabulary (consequence-first, load-bearing = what breaks if removed) vs geometry vocabulary (shape-first, silent on consequence) per founder's own follow-up direction. https://okemily.com/blog/load-bearing/
title: Principle 17 -- Load-Bearing, plus a blog post on it
